## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 20-juan early-Northern-Sòng comprehensive military treatise by Xǔ Dòng, completed in *Xiánpíng* 3 (1000). The work covers the full range of pre-Sòng military classical theory plus extensive practical-administrative material on troop deployment, fortification, frontier strategy, and military astrology. Composition: precisely datable to 1000. The frontmatter brackets to 1000–1000.

**Abstract**

The *Hǔ qián jīng* is the principal pre-*Wǔ jīng zǒng yào* ([KR3b0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3b/KR3b0012)) Northern Sòng military treatise. Substantively superseded by the imperial *Wǔ jīng zǒng yào* of 1044, but substantively important as a private-scholarly compilation of the same generation.

The bibliographic record: *Sòng shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Bīngjiā lèi*.
